title.narrative: Smart Agric Practices and Livelihood Initiatives for Nigeria Women

description.narrative: In Nigeria, women make up a sizable portion of the agricultural labour force and work in various capacities, including crop production, livestock rearing, and agro-processing. Their assistance is vital to rural households' and communities' survival. Their productivity and economic potential are, however, constrained by gender differences in training, decision-making authority, and resource availability. To achieve sustainable agricultural development, economic empowerment, and enhanced food security, Nigerian women's livelihood initiatives and the application of smart agricultural practices are critical. The objective of this project is to generate enduring benefits for women and their communities by tackling the distinct obstacles encountered by them in the agriculture sector and furnishing them with the required resources and assistance. In addition to providing a means of achieving economic expansion, supporting women's empowerment in agriculture is essential to Nigeria's quest for gender parity and sustainable development. The project is expected to work in collaboration with State Ministry of Women Affairs and Social Development, State Ministry of Agriculture and Olam Farms Nigeria Ltd in mobilization and linkage to training of 300 – 500 young women into the “Crown Flour Mills Angels” program – an intervention that build capacity of women in baking and other confectionary crafts. The project will mobilize, link to training and follow-up of project participants results and progress.
